description: This file defines a servlet class 'ModuleResourcesServlet' which handles HTTP GET requests to serve module resource files within the OpenMRS platform, supporting resource caching and development mode resource loading.

classes.name: ModuleResourcesServlet
classes.description: A servlet for serving static resources related to modules in the OpenMRS platform, with caching and development support.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Provides the last modified timestamp of the resource file for HTTP caching purposes.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to serve the requested module resource file with appropriate headers.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Resolves the requested resource path to a file on the server, considering module context and development mode.
